submitted.rationale: Index 20 (Sb 0.624) had the highest measured EQE, 0.0559%. EQE values were 0.0173 at Sb 0.36, 0.0116 at 0.50, 0.0442 at 0.59, 0.0559 at 0.62 and 0.0463 at 0.67, so the maximum sits near 0.62. By XRD, 0.62–0.71 is a single Sb-rich phase (film reflection near Q≈2.04–2.08 plus a weak peak near Q≈3.40, on top of the FTO peaks). At 0.57 there are extra reflections (Q≈3.33, 3.90), which points to a mixed or Pb-rich phase. The film peak is strongest in this phase at 0.62 and weakens as Sb increases.
